messages:
maria: Heads-up: deploybot triggered a timed fallback during the 23:00-00:00 change window — canary 25% -> hold at 25% and 10m timer fired. Seeing p95 jump on inference-hosts-usw2. @deploybot details?

deploybot: automated-signal: canary_hold -> triggered at 2834567000. reason: p95_latency > 180ms for 3m. fallback_policy: timed_fallback(10m) -> revert-to-stable if not cleared. traffic_snapshot: stable=75% canary=25%. cmd: `redwoodctl rollout pause --id rollout-2026-11-23-01`

ajay: I pulled traces — KV cache misses spiked during the canary, looks like a kernel selection mismatch on quantized path. p95 ~290ms for 5m, error rate small but latency customer-impacting.

ops_lead: Do we auto-revert after the 10m? What's the criteria for manual rollback override? we should decide quickly before deploybot flips.

maria: Prefer manual rollback here. Criteria proposal: 1) p95 sustained >200ms for >=5m OR 2) error rate >1% of requests OR 3) customer-facing 5xx spike (total >0.5% baseline) OR 4) model quality regression on smoke prompts (>10% failure). If any met, ops have authority to pin and revert.

ajay: +1 to that. Add a fifth: unexplained memory OOMs or pod restarts >1/hr on canary.

ops_lead: Agreed. Procedure: step A) Pause rollout (if not paused) B) Notify cs & oncall C) Pin canary customers to stable by traffic split D) Execute revert/pin and validate. Draft commands below.

linda: Drafting quick comms for customers impacted by 25% canary: "We observed degraded inference latency during a routine rollout; traffic has been routed back to the previous stable model while we investigate. No data exposure. We'll follow up with ETA." Want one-liner for status page.

eli: Also loop in Support and SRE channels, and update release notes: revert reason + root cause note later. We should also record the rollout id and commit hash.

maria: rollout id: rollout-2026-11-23-01 commit: b7f9c2d. Suggested immediate actions: 
- `redwoodctl rollout pause --id rollout-2026-11-23-01`
- `redwoodctl traffic split --id rollout-2026-11-23-01 --to stable:100,canary:0` (pin to stable)
- `redwoodctl rollout mark-failed --id rollout-2026-11-23-01 --reason "p95 latency regression"`

ajay: If we need a full revert instead of traffic pin, run: ```
redwoodctl rollout revert --service inference --to-version v2.4.1 --from-rollout rollout-2026-11-23-01 --note "latency regression/kvcache kernel mismatch"
```

ops_lead: Who is owning the customer comms? @linda take lead, @eli coordinate support notices. I'll own the exec rollback if we need it.

linda: I'll post to status and ping top 5 customers via CS incident thread. Draft status: "Investigating elevated inference latency; routing back to stable model for affected traffic. No customer data at risk. ETA for update: 60m." Thoughts?

eli: That works. Add link to temporary troubleshooting doc and include contact for urgent cases.

maria: Oncall @ajay run quick smoke after traffic pin: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'` share p95 numbers.

ajay: Doing smoke now. preliminary p95 after pin: 85ms, no errors. I'll monitor for 15m and report.

deploybot: automated-note: timed_fallback window elapsed at 2834567060 -> no auto-revert executed because ops paused the rollout.

maria: Good. Keep monitoring. After 15m with stable numbers we'll close the thread and file a post-deploy incident with root cause (kernel selection on quantized path). Also add a follow-up action item to improve canary gating: KV-cache cold-start simulation in canary smoke tests.

ops_lead: Action items: 1) Incident ticket+RCA owner 2) Update rollout gating to include KV cache miss delta 3) Add explicit canary kernel flag matrix test. I'll create the ticket.

eli: I'll coordinate the customer messages and post the status update in 10m.

linda: status posted. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-1123-01

ajay: continuing monitor - will report back at 2834567350 with final 15m summary.

maria: Thanks team. Final note: keep deploy window owners in the loop for future rollouts in this change window (we may shift heavy inference rollouts out of 23:00-00:00). :eyes:
